title: Do you really know me?
status: Draft for the gauntlet. English first, gender neutral. zh is Sally's Chinese where it exists (zhStatus says how it was touched); zhSally keeps her original when the meaning had to change.

sources.note: Level 2 reads each card's `friend` field from the chapter files. level2.cards is a snapshot computed from the chapter files listed here; if a chapter changes, recompute it with level2.answerMapping (the rule is authoritative, the snapshot is a convenience).

rules.noFreeText: No typing anywhere in the friend game, for the owner or the friend. Sally's 'why did you guess this?' field became one-tap reason chips (level2.whyChips); her roast box became 'pick the roast' (level4.pickTheRoast). The friend label is picked, not typed (tokens.friend).
rules.neverShown: Cards with privacy intimate or locked18 never appear in any level. Sally's Q07 never appears in any version. Sting lines are owner only, except the bestie Level 4 sting pick, which the owner must switch on.
rules.timing: About 5 minutes (friend version, 3 levels) or 6 minutes (bestie, 4 levels), per Sally.
rules.friendSeesOnly: The friend sees their Level 1 score, optional counts for Levels 2 and 3 (never which ones), and the owner's type name if the owner shared it. Everything else is owner only.
rules.noEmDash: No em dash characters in any line.

tokens.{name}: The owner's display name from their profile setting (not typed in this flow).
tokens.{they}: Owner pronoun, subject. she / he / they. zh: 她 / 他 / TA.
tokens.{them}: Owner pronoun, object. her / him / them. zh: 她 / 他 / TA.
tokens.{their}: Owner pronoun, possessive. her / his / their. zh: 她的 / 他的 / TA的.
tokens.{friend}: The link label, picked by the owner when sending, never typed: the relationship word plus one of 12 preset emoji, e.g. 'Bestie 🐸' or 'Partner 🌙'. zh: 閨蜜 🐸, 另一半 🌙. If the platform later knows the friend's display name, use that. The friend is always 'they' in copy (their pronouns are not collected). zh uses TA for the friend.
tokens.{N}: Number of the owner's tags in this link's Level 3 (1 to 5).
tokens.grammarRule: {they} is followed only by a modal (would, could, can, will, might), a past tense verb or 'd, never a present tense verb or 're, 've, 's, so the line reads right for she, he and they. Card authors: write '{name} has' instead of '{they} has'.

level1.title: Level 1: Guess the type
level1.intro: Six quick calls. Each one is a side of {name}.
rules: 6 either-or questions, one per axis, in this order: R1, R2, R3, L1, L2, L3. Option order is randomized per friend.
Each option carries its pole (+1 is the first pole in types.json, -1 the second). A pick matches when its pole equals the sign of the owner's axis.
Flex axis (owner has the Flex badge): either pick counts as a hit. Unfinished axis (owner never finished it): either pick counts as a hit, and the result says so.
The six picks build the guessed type: R1 x R2 x R3 gives the relationship half-name, L1 x L2 x L3 the life half-name (types.json). The friend sees the guessed type after question 6.
Score = hits out of 6, shown as {x}/6 on both result pages.

Wording sets (relationships.options[].level1Set): partner and crush get `friend`, friend or coworker gets `everyday` (the `friend` set with an R1 question that has no love or family framing), bestie gets `bestie`.

flexLine.t: {name} lives on both sides of this one. Either guess counts.

unfinishedLine.t: Genii hasn't called this side of {name} yet, so either guess counts.

level2.title: Level 2: Guess {name}'s choices
level2.intro: 12 situations. Pick what {name} would really do, not what you would.
rules: 12 cards, each the card's `friend` field (third person, 2 options). Option order is randomized per friend.
The right answer is the side the owner's own answer maps to (answerMapping). A card enters the deck only when that side is clear.

answerMapping.rule: Build a signed vector for the owner's chosen option: each axis value as is; each tag as +strength for an A tag and -strength for a B tag, on its pair (T08A s2 is T08 +2). Do the same for friend side a and side b. Match score = dot product over the dimensions each side names. The owner's answer maps to the side with the higher positive score. Zero, a tie or negative on both means no clear side.
answerMapping.pickTwo: Add the vectors of both picks first, then match.
answerMapping.snapshot: level2.cards[id].answerMap lists the mapped side per owner option, in option order (null = no clear side, circumstance, or depends).

eligibility.include: The card has a `friend` field, its level is allowed for the relationship, and the owner's answer maps clearly to a or b.
exclude: Owner skipped it, tapped 'Not my life' or 'No recent example'.
Owner picked a circumstance option (Sally's 只能這樣) or a 'depends' option (Sally's 兩邊都認同).
Owner's answer maps to no clear side (answerMap null).
Owner's answer was rushed (under 1.5 s). The friend should never be marked wrong on a tap the owner did not mean.
Card privacy intimate or locked18, or no friend field (feeling and sealed cards never appear).
Card level not allowed for this relationship (relationships.options[].cardLevels).
Owner under 18 and the card's teenOk is false (the friend prompt would describe a situation the owner never saw).
Owner never saw the card (gated or not reached).

selection: 1. Start from the primary list for the relationship (primary.friend or primary.bestie), in order. Drop every card that fails eligibility.

2. Axis rescue: for each axis that a dropped primary card carried and that no remaining card covers, take the first eligible card in backupOrder that carries that axis and whose tag pairs are not already in the deck.
3. Fill: walk backupOrder and add each eligible card whose tag pairs are not already in the deck, until there are 12.
4. Still short: walk backupOrder again and allow a repeated tag pair (never the same card twice).
5. Still under 12: play what exists. Under 6 eligible cards: skip Level 2 and show level2.skippedLine.

Order: a replacement takes the slot of the card it replaced; rescue and fill cards go into the earliest empty slot. Then, if two neighbors share a chapter or a tag pair, move the later one down to the next slot that breaks the clash.

primary.why: Both lists cover all six axes, 12 different tag pairs and at least 6 chapters, with no two neighbors from one chapter, so no pair or topic repeats (LESSONS-FROM-TEST-1: repetition). friend follows Sally's friend set (Q05, Q15/Q27 as one money-and-friends card, Q21/Q24 as one family card, Q25/Q37, Q33, Q41, Q45/Q20, Q46 swapped for everyday picks) with Q06 removed (intimate). bestie follows Sally's bestie set (Q05, Q08, Q23, Q24, Q25, Q26, Q28, Q29, Q33, plus Q48, Q02 and Q01 so every axis is covered); Q15, Q21 and Q36 moved to backup because they repeat a pair (T06, T19, T14).

level2.backupWhy: Sally's fixed backup order, extended to every card with a friend field. Unused tag pairs come first, then cards that rescue an axis, then everything else.

C1-4 side b, C1-8 side b and C1-2 side b used raw pronouns for the owner. Fixed in verification: '{their} closest person', '{Their} own version', 'Keeps {their} own'.

bestie.t: Which of these 12 are the real {name}? Pick {N}.
bestie.zh: 這12張裡，哪幾張是{name}本人？選{N}張。

level3.cardFace: Tag name and heart line only. Never the sting, triggers or evidence.

deck.allowedPairs: Pairs allowed by the relationship (relationships.options[].tagPairs) and the owner's toggles. Owner under 18, or friend tapped Under 18: marriageKids pairs are never allowed.
deck.true: N = the owner's shown tags (up to 5, strongest first) whose pair is allowed. These are the true cards.
deck.opposite: N cards: the pair partner of each true card.
deck.decoys: 12 - 2N cards drawn at random from allowed pairs the owner has no fired tag in (shown or not, per Sally: never a pair already hit): one card per pair, random side, never a pair already in the deck. Only if those run out does a fired-but-not-shown pair fill in, showing the side the owner did not fire.
deck.shuffle: All 12 shuffled; true cards never sit in fixed positions.
deck.pick: The friend must pick exactly N.
deck.zeroN: If N is 0 after filtering (every owner tag is in a pair this relationship hides), Level 3 is skipped with level3.skippedLine.
deck.fewTags: N of 1 or 2 means 8 or 10 decoys; show fewTagsLine before the round and on the owner's result.

scoring.trueHit: Picked a true card: a hit ({z}), goes to 'They get you'.
scoring.opposite: Picked an opposite card: no hit, goes to 'Who they think you are'.
scoring.missedTrue: A true card not picked: goes to 'What they don't see'.
scoring.decoy: Picked a decoy: no penalty, listed under 'Other sides they guessed'.

fewTagsLine.t: {name} only has {N} tags, so this one is hard.

skippedLine.t: {name}'s tags are private on this link, so this round sits out.

level4.availableFor: bestie only, and only when the owner switched on sting lines (default off).
level4.title: Bonus round: which line gets {name}?

prompt.t: Which of these 4 lines would leave {name} speechless for three seconds?
prompt.zh: 這4句話裡，哪一句說中{name}、會讓{they}沉默三秒？

deck: 1 true line: the sting of the owner's strongest shown tag whose pair is allowed on this link (skip to the next tag if the top one is hidden).

3 other lines: stings of tags from pairs the owner has no fired tag in (fired-but-not-shown pairs only as a fallback, and never a tag the owner fired), allowed on this link (love only if love tags are on; marriageKids only if opted in and everyone is 18+), at least 2 of them from a different chapter than the true line.
Shuffled. The friend picks 1. No penalty for a miss.
stingPick.friendNeverSees: Which line was true. The friend's result does not mention Level 4.

prompt.t: Pick the roast {name} would laugh at hardest.
prompt.zh: 選一句吐槽{name}，{they}看了會笑的那種。
prompt.zhStatus: edited: Sally's free-text roast box became presets
prompt.zhSally: 用一句話吐槽{名字}，她看了會笑的那種。

pickTheRoast.guardLine: Jokes only. Every line here is Genii-approved.
pickTheRoast.show: 6 of the 13 lines: every line whose tag or its pair is one of the owner's shown tags (up to 3, strongest tags first), then random others; love-tied lines only if love tags are on. Shuffled.
pickTheRoast.rules: Every line roasts a move, never the person: never looks, body, weight, health or diagnoses. The owner can hide any roast from their page with one tap.

roasts.t: Answers texts on a three-to-five business day schedule. Still my favorite.
Knows the barista's name, the barista's dog's name and its birthday.
Asked for a quick opinion once. Got notes, bullet points and a follow-up.
Says 'I'm saving this month.' Pays for everyone's bubble tea anyway.
Forgave everyone years ago. The screenshots folder did not.
Says 'we're keeping it casual.' Already knows their coffee order by heart.
Sent me a payment request for $3.47. For fries. With a fries emoji.
Booked the flight first. Checked the bank app second. Maybe.
Calls it 'just a side project.' It has a logo and a five-year plan.
Can't pick a new phone case without a family vote.
Made a spreadsheet for the group trip. It has tabs. Plural.
Has ordered the exact same thing at our spot since the day we met.
Bragged about a $12 dupe for a full week. Unprompted.

stingHit.t: {friend} picked the exact line that gets you. That's a bestie.
stingHit.zh: TA一眼就挑中戳你的那一句。這就是閨蜜。

stingMiss.t: {friend} thought "{pickedLine}" would get you. It's actually "{trueLine}".

results.roastOnTrueTag: Called out, lovingly. That roast is one of your real tags: {tagName}.
results.roastOnOpposite: {friend} roasted the you they imagine. Genii has you down as {trueTagName}.
results.roastOther: Genii didn't flag this one. {friend} might know something Genii doesn't.
results.roastSkipped: {friend} kept the roast to themselves. Merciful.

typeComparison.t: {friend} thinks you're {guessedType}. You're {trueType}. They read {x}/6 sides of you.
typeComparison.zh: TA以為你是：{guessedType}　其實你是：{trueType}　TA看懂了你的 {x}/6 面。
typeComparison.flexNote: You're flex on {axisName}, so either guess counted.

6.t: {friend} sees right through you. Slightly scary.
6.zh: TA把你看得很透，有點可怕。

0-1.t: The you in {friend}'s head and the real you are almost two different people. That's the fun part.
0-1.zh: TA眼中的你，跟你本人幾乎是兩個人。這才是最有意思的地方。

2-3.t: {friend} sees half of you. The other half is worth a talk tonight.
2-3.zh: TA看到的是你的一半。另一半，值得今晚聊聊。

4-5.t: {friend} gets most of you. The side or two they missed is the part you haven't shown them yet.
4-5.zh: TA懂你大部分的樣子，剩下那一兩面，是你還沒給TA看的。

6.t: Certified soul bestie. {friend} might know you better than you do.
6.zh: 認證靈魂閨蜜。TA可能比你還懂你。
6.zhStatus: edited (姐妹 to 閨蜜, 她 to TA)
6.zhSally: 認證靈魂姐妹。她可能比你還懂你。

0-1.t: {friend} pictures someone pretty different. Bubble tea is on them tonight. Talk it out.
0-1.zh: TA眼中的你和本人差很多，今晚奶茶TA請，好好聊聊。

2-3.t: {friend} knows the you that shows up around them. The rest of you, they haven't met yet.
2-3.zh: TA認識的是跟TA在一起時的你。其他時候的你，TA還沒見過。

4-5.t: {friend} knows most of you. The rest, you're still keeping to yourself.
4-5.zh: TA懂你大部分的樣子，剩下的，你還藏在心裡。

getYou.title: They get you
getYou.sub: Every side {friend} called right, with the line you love about it.
getYou.empty: Nothing matched this time. Plenty to talk about, then.

dontSee.title: What they don't see
dontSee.sub: The tags {friend} missed, and the line that stings because it's true. Best screenshot on this page.
dontSee.empty: They found every tag. Nothing slipped past {friend}.

thinkYouAre.title: Who they think you are
thinkYouAre.empty: No mix-ups. {friend} didn't fall for a single opposite.

otherGuesses.title: Other sides they guessed
otherGuesses.item: {friend} also sees you as {decoyTagName}. Genii didn't pick that up. Maybe {friend} knows something.

zones.sources: axis poleName and poleLine from types.json axes (plus/minus, plusLine/minusLine); tag name, heart and sting from tags.json. Stings stay owner only.

biggestMiss.title: Biggest surprise
biggestMiss.zhStatus: edited from Sally's example (他以為你會把錢存起來，你其實想拿去旅行)
biggestMiss.none: Zero misses. {friend} called every one. Slightly terrifying.
biggestMiss.pickRule: Among missed Level 2 cards: highest card weight (real 0.80, scenario 0.55, this_or_that, role and pick_two 0.45) times the owner's match score; x1.5 if the friend also missed that card's axis in Level 1; tie goes to the earlier card. Texts are the friend-side option texts (guessed side and the owner's side).

screenshot.note: Contains only the type comparison and the zones the owner ticks.

sendAnother.t: Send to someone else and compare
sendAnother.zh: 再發給另一個人比比看

friend.t: You read {x}/6 sides of {name}. Everything you missed, {name} can see. Want to know which? Ask {them}.
friend.zh: 你看懂了{they}的 {x}/6 面。你猜錯的地方，{they}都看到了。想知道是哪幾題，去問{they}。

bestie.t: You read {x}/6 sides of {name}. Want to know which side you missed? Ask {them}.
bestie.zh: 你看懂了{name}的 {x}/6 面。想知道你漏掉了哪一面？去問{they}。

counts.note: Counts only, never which ones. Level 4 is never shown to the friend.

typeReveal.note: Only when the owner's showType toggle is on.

friend.t: Your turn: see if {name} really knows you

bestie.t: Your turn: see if {name} knows you best too
bestie.zh: 換你測，看{they}是不是也最懂你

yourTurn.loop: Starts the friend's own quiz run. When they finish, their friend game link to {name} is pre-made with the same relationship, so {name} becomes the guesser.

bestieVsPartner.unlock: At least one bestie link and one partner link have been played. With no partner link, a crush link can stand in (title then reads 'Bestie vs crush').
bestieVsPartner.locked: Send it to a bestie and a partner. When both have played, this opens.
bestieVsPartner.basis: Level 1 and Level 3 hits, as in Sally.

rows.t: When it comes to knowing you, {winner} is ahead of {other} by {n}.
rows.zh: 在懂你這件事上，{winner}贏了{other}{n}格。
rows.tie: Dead even. They each know a different you.

rows.t: This side of you, you can't hide.
rows.items: axes and tags both called right

rows.t: This side, you only show your bestie.
This side only comes out around {partner}.
rows.zh: 這一面，你只在{partner}面前出現。

rows.t: This side, not even they know yet.
rows.zh: 這一面，連他們都還不知道。

privacy.t: Only you can see this. Nobody gets notified.
privacy.zh: 這個畫面只有你看得到，不會通知任何人。

bestieVsPartner.share: Share only the tiles you tick.

ranking.sub: Only you can see this. Nobody gets notified.
ranking.locked: One down. Send it to one more person to start the ranking.
ranking.tie: Tied. Genii calls it a draw.
ranking.sort: By hit rate (Level 1 hits + Level 3 hits) / (6 + N for that link), as Sally ranks by Levels 1 and 3; the rate keeps links fair when a relationship hides some tags. Ties: more Level 2 hits, then whoever played first.

choicesMade: R2 in Level 1 measures directness only in both versions. Sally's friend F2 and bestie F2 asked about being exhausted, which the brief names as R2's known problem.
R3 in Level 1 uses holidays and home, not marriage, so a teen owner's friends can answer (brief: R3 measurable by teens).
Sally's optional 'why did you guess this?' text field became 4 one-tap chips; her bestie roast box became 'pick the roast' from 12 presets (brief: no free text).
The friend label is the relationship plus a preset emoji so nobody types a name.

Marriage and kids tags: opt-in only for partner and bestie. Sally allowed any recipient to see them if the owner opted in; 'friend or coworker' includes coworkers, so this build never offers them there or to a crush.
Level 2 skips rushed owner answers (under 1.5 s), so a friend is never marked wrong on a tap the owner did not mean (LESSONS-FROM-TEST-1: rushed taps).
Sally's primary sets repeated a pair (Q21 and Q24 both family vote T19; Q15 and Q27/Q28 both T06). Primaries here use 12 different pairs; the repeats are in backup.
Level 4 sting decoys come only from pairs the owner has no tag in, so exactly one line is true.
Roast lines cover 12 different pairs across all 7 chapters; one is love-tied (R06) and hides when love tags are off.
open: Sally's crush version keeps love cards in Level 2 (Q05, Q06) but hides love tags in Level 3 unless opted in. Kept as is; say if a crush should see no love cards at all.
Bestie vs partner could also compare two besties or two partners. Built only as specified.
